claim: Kdenlive powerful free and open-source video editor; downloads include stable releases and experimental daily builds
Tech stack: C++, MLT, Qt and KDE Frameworks 6, frei0r, LADSPA
Primary development on KDE Invent with GitHub mirror; contributions via KDE GitLab
Acronym for KDE Non-Linear Video Editor; works on Linux, Windows, macOS and BSD
Effects and transitions: hundreds of audio and video effects, keyframes, transitions, compositions
